title: Rockefellers fund Greer, Mack and the Princeton lab

tellings.quote: So the Rockefellers funded Steven Greer in the nineties-
And they funded the Princeton Parasychology Lab which was studying mind over matter.
tellings.difference: Puts the weight on the Princeton lab and says it was studying mind over matter.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of 1990s Rockefeller funding that included the Princeton parapsychology lab, alongside Greer and Mack.

as_told.title: Rockefeller funding of the Princeton parapsychology lab

tellings.quote: Lawrence Rockefeller was a patron for a lot of early UFO research. He funded John Mack.
tellings.difference: Names Laurance Rockefeller specifically, adds Whitley Strieber and a Teton ranch, and leaves out the Princeton lab.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about Rockefeller money funding 1990s UFO researchers, including Mack and Greer.

as_told.title: Laurance Rockefeller as patron of UFO research

plain: In the 1990s the Rockefeller family, especially Laurance Rockefeller, acted as patron to early UFO research, funding the UFO campaigner Steven Greer, the researcher John Mack, and a parapsychology lab at Princeton that studied mind over matter, Michels says. He says it himself on three different episodes, without naming a source, and the details shift: once he stresses the Princeton lab, and once he names Laurance Rockefeller, adds the writer Whitley Strieber and a ranch in the Tetons, and leaves the lab out. If true, it would mean one of America's richest families was quietly bankrolling the field.
